ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory enhanced due diligence under Viet Nam's AML Law, requiring cross-verification against PEP lists (foreign and domestic), OFAC SDN list, UN Security Council consolidated list, and domestic Viet Nam sanctions/wanted lists; screening must be conducted continuously and re-executed at onboarding and upon any substantive change with audit-trail record retention of at least 10 years pursuant to Decree No. 03/2023/ND-CP.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: National Business Registration Portal of Viet Nam (https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn) administered by the Ministry of Planning and Investment; foreign-invested filings consolidated through the one-stop-shop electronic system via the provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI).
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Enterprise names must be written in the Vietnamese script using Latin letters and permitted diacritics; names must include the entity form identifier ('TNHH' for LLC). Foreign-invested companies may supplement a foreign-language name, but the legal name for clearance is the transliterated Vietnamese version. The name must not be identical or confusingly similar to any already-registered enterprise name, must not conflict with protected trade names/copyrights, and must follow the order of 'descriptive clause + TNHH' regulations under Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the enterprise name is rejected, the applicant may file a formal administrative appeal with the Director of the provincial Department of Planning and Investment within 30 days of receipt of rejection. The appeal must state full grounds and provide amended name alternatives. If the DPI maintains rejection, the next remand may be filed to the Ministry of Planning and Investment within 30 days, or a judicial administrative complaint may be brought to the administrative court under Law No. 11/2023/QH15 on Execution of Administrative Judgments, ultimately allowing statutory name-clearance re-application without prejudice after 60 days.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permitted for this industry class. An equity crowdfunding portal must maintain a physical, fixed, identifiable office address in Viet Nam with actual operational presence and staff capable of meeting regulatory inspections by the State Securities Commission and the State Bank of Viet Nam. Virtual-office-only registration is disallowed under the Securities Law and AML supervision requirements.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Aggregate risk classified as High (subject to unannounced on-site inspections; estimated likelihood of a physical inspection within first 12–18 months after licensing is >65% given the High-Risk Special License tag and AML/CFT monitoring mandate).

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 (effective 01 January 2021), Articles 25, 47-60, 73-89 (formation of limited liability companies, charter contents, members' council powers, and legal representative rules); Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14, Articles 36-38 (foreign investment registration procedure and Investment Registration Certificate issuance); Law on Securities No. 54/2019/QH14, Articles 74-76 and 85-90 (licensed securities services, professional certification of personnel, and operational conditions applicable to an equity crowdfunding portal selling or facilitating startup equity offerings); Decree No. 01/2021/NĐ-CP, Articles 23-28 (dossier and procedures for enterprise registration); Decree No. 155/2020/NĐ-CP (conditions and licensing criteria for securities intermediaries); draft Decree on Equity Crowdfunding (Huy động vốn cộng đồng) administered by the State Securities Commission under the fintech regulatory pilot programme.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) of the province or centrally governed city where the head office is located (for Ho Chi Minh City: DPI-HCMC; for Hanoi: DPI-Hanoi), or the Management Board of Industrial Zones / Export Processing Zones if the registered office is located inside an industrial zone; all applications are submitted electronically through the National Business Registration Portal (NBRP) at https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn, with the investment component processed on the National Investment Registration System (VIET SIC).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Enterprise Registration (Giấy đề nghị đăng ký doanh nghiệp, Form I-1 prescribed under Decree No. 01/2021/NĐ-CP), accompanied by the Company Charter (Điều lệ công ty), the List of Members, copies of the approved Investment Registration Certificate, and legal-entity or identity documentation of all contributing members.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: There is no statutory minimum charter capital for a general foreign-invested LLC under the Law on Enterprises; however, the equity crowdfunding portal service is a conditional business line requiring a licensed intermediation for securities-related crowdfunding, and the State Securities Commission's draft Crowdfunding Decree and the fintech pilot programme require a minimum paid-up charter capital of VND 10,000,000,000 (approximately USD 400,000), which must be fully contributed in cash within 90 days after the Enterprise Registration Certificate is issued. The capital must be escrowed at a licensed commercial bank in Vietnam until the portal operating license is granted, with the bank issuing a written confirmation of the escrow balance to the licensing authority; withdrawal of the escrow funds prior to licensure is strictly prohibited without SSC written consent.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
FIRST MEMBERS' COUNCIL RESOLUTION / OWNER'S DECISION OF [COMPANY NAME] (THE 'COMPANY')

Adopted by unanimous written consent of the members on [date] at the Company's registered office: [address], [district], [province/city], Viet Nam.

Whereas the Company has been incorporated as a foreign-invested limited liability company under the Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 and registered with the Department of Planning and Investment of [province/city] under Enterprise Registration Certificate No. [number] dated [date];

Whereas the Company intends to operate a digital intermediary platform for regulated startup equity offerings (equity crowdfunding portal), which constitutes a conditional securities-related activity under the Law on Securities No. 54/2019/QH14 and requires a license from the State Securities Commission;

NOW, THEREFORE, IT IS HEREBY RESOLVED AS FOLLOWS:

1. Share Capital Subscription. The members ratify and confirm the subscription to the Company's charter capital in the amount of [amount in figures] Vietnamese Dong (VND [amount in words]), allocated as follows: [Member A, domiciled at [address], subscribing [percentage] of the charter capital; Member B, domiciled at [address], subscribing [percentage] of the charter capital]. Each member shall contribute his/her/its subscribed capital in full by cash remittance to the Company's escrow capital account at [name of licensed commercial bank] within 90 days of the Enterprise Registration Certificate date. The bank's written escrow confirmation shall be delivered to the State Securities Commission as a condition precedent to the portal operating license.

2. Registered Office. The Company's registered office is hereby designated as [full address, district, province/city]. The General Director is authorized to execute and manage the office lease, maintain statutory registers at the registered office, file any address changes with the Department of Planning and Investment through the National Business Registration Portal, and maintain the Company's charter, seal specimen, and corporate records at that address.

3. Appointment of Officers. (a) [Name], [nationality] passport No. [number], is hereby appointed General Director and Legal Representative of the Company, with full authority to act singly to bind the Company in the ordinary course of business, to sign and submit all license applications, escrow agreements, service agreements, tax filings, and contracts, and to represent the Company before the State Securities Commission, the Department of Planning and Investment, the tax authority, banks, and all other state agencies. (b) [Name], [nationality] passport No. [number], is hereby appointed Chief Compliance Officer, with responsibility for the design and enforcement of Anti-Money Laundering / Counter-Financing of Terrorism (AML/CFT) policies, investor and issuer on-boarding verification, suspicious-transaction reporting, and all securities-licensing compliance matters. (c) [Name of licensed audit firm] is hereby appointed the Company's external auditor.

4. Corporate Governance. The Company shall comply with the governance provisions of its Charter, the Law on Enterprises, the Law on Securities, and all SSC circulars. The Members' Council shall meet at least once annually; all minutes, capital contribution ledgers, and investment records shall be preserved for a minimum of 10 years. The General Director shall implement an effective system of internal controls and compliance testing for the portal's operations.

5. Delegation of Authority. Each officer is authorized to take any action necessary or desirable to give effect to this Resolution, including without limitation opening bank and escrow accounts, receiving contributed funds, submitting applications on the National Business Registration Portal and the SSC licensing system, engaging subcontractors and technology vendors, and signing employment agreements.

6. Effectiveness. This Resolution takes effect immediately upon adoption by unanimous written consent and supersedes all prior inconsistent actions.

Adopted on [date].

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) - Foreign Investment Registration Section / Management Board of Industrial and Export Processing Zones; online filing via the National Investment Registration System (VIET SIC).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prior to enterprise registration, the foreign investors must secure an IRC under Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14. Prepare and submit the investment registration dossier electronically and in paper form (if requested) to the DPI of the intended province. The project will be assessed against the conditional business line of digital securities intermediation; approval is processed in the standard non-concessional route. The DPI consults with the State Securities Commission where the project involves a regulated securities service. After the IRC is granted, the investor proceeds to Step 2. The IRC contains the legal capital, investment objective, and the permitted crowdfunding portal activity.
required_dossiers: Investment registration application in the form prescribed at Appendix A.I.1 of Decree No. 31/2021/NĐ-CP
Certified copy of the passport of each individual investor and of the beneficial owner
Certificate of incorporation or equivalent legal-entity registration of each corporate investor, together with articles of association and audited financial statements for the latest fiscal year
Financial capability statement evidencing sufficient unencumbered funds for the registered capital of at least VND 10 billion
Detailed project proposal describing the equity crowdfunding portal business model, target investors, technology stack, and compliance program
Power of attorney to the lead contact or authorized representative, notarized in accordance with Vietnamese law
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the dossier is incomplete, the DPI issues a written request for amendments within 10 working days; the investor may cure within 30 days. If the IRC application is denied, the investor may file an administrative appeal to the provincial People's Committee within 30 days of the refusal notice, or initiate a case before the Administrative Court. Alternatively, the investor may revise the project scope and resubmit a new dossier without prejudice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Enterprise Registration and Issuance of Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) via the National Business Registration Portal (NBRP) at https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After receiving the IRC, the investor completes the enterprise registration application online on the NBRP. The applicant must elect the LLC corporate form, list the ISIC 6499 / securities-related activities, and attach the approved IRC as a mandatory annex. The charter (Điều lệ công ty) must contain the statutory clauses required by Article 23 of the Law on Enterprises. The DPI will issue the ERC electronically upon validation. The ERC constitutes conclusive proof of the company's legal personality. The company's existence starts from the date of issuance; thereafter it may open bank accounts, lease premises, and execute contracts, but may not operate the crowdfunding portal until separately licensed.
required_dossiers: Application for Enterprise Registration (Form I-1) generated and signed electronically on the NBRP
Company Charter (Điều lệ công ty) signed by all members, including capital contribution amounts and ratios
List of members (Form I-2) with full names, addresses, and certified identity documents
Certified copy of the approved Investment Registration Certificate
Power of attorney executed by all members authorizing the company's legal representative to submit the dossier
Written confirmation of the registered office lease or a notarized consent of the premises owner to use the address as head office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the NBRP returns a query or the DPI issues a request for supplements, the applicant must correct the dossier within 30 days; failure to cure leads to rejection. The applicant may refile an amended application immediately. Any rejection notice must state reasons in writing; the applicant may appeal to the Director of the DPI within 10 working days and thereafter to the provincial People's Committee, followed by administrative court proceedings.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Seal Specimen Registration, Legal Representative Notification, and Capital Escrow Account Opening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) for seal and legal representative notifications; licensed commercial bank for the escrow account; Viet Nam Social Security for employer registration.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 15 days of seal creation, the company must submit the seal specimen and the model signature of the legal representative on the NBRP (Form I-7). Simultaneously, the General Director opens a charter capital escrow account at a licensed commercial bank, deposits the VND 10 billion minimum capital, and obtains a bank confirmation letter evidencing the escrow balance. The bank account must be designated as a restricted escrow account, disallowing disbursement without SSC approval. The company also registers as an employer with the provincial Social Security office. The tax registration, license tax declaration, and labor registration are automatically activated with the ERC data feed to the General Department of Taxation and can be completed online within the same step.
required_dossiers: Announcement of seal specimen and legal representative (Form I-7 under Decree 01/2021/NĐ-CP)
Corporate seal with one specimen for archival impression
First Members' Council Resolution appointing the General Director and Chief Compliance Officer and confirming the capital escrow arrangement
Company ERC and IRC (notarized copies) for bank account opening
Bank account opening application package including identification of the legal representative and proof of physical presence
Employer registration forms for social and health insurance with the provincial Social Security office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the DPI rejects the seal notification due to administrative error, file a corrected Form I-7; notification is ministerial and typically cured within one working day. If the bank refuses escrow account opening, choose another licensed bank and resubmit; a bank refusal does not trigger a government remedy. In the event of a data mismatch between the tax database and the ERC, apply to the provincial tax office for a manual correction; written proof of payment of license tax and submission of the employer registration will cure the mismatch.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: State Securities Commission License for Equity Crowdfunding Portal Operations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: State Securities Commission (UBCKNN) - Market Supervision Department and Licensing Division, Ministry of Finance of Viet Nam; online submission via the SSC e-portal and physical submission at UBCKNN head office in Hanoi.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a formal license application to operate an equity crowdfunding portal in the form prescribed under the SSC pilot programme / draft Crowdfunding Decree. The application must demonstrate technical readiness of the platform, investor protection procedures, IT security architecture, and AML/CFT systems. Upon initial review, the SSC will schedule an operational readiness inspection or a demonstration session for the portal's workflow (issuer onboarding, cap-table management, payment escrow instructions, and investor onboarding). The license, once granted, will be subject to ongoing reporting obligations and annual audits. The company may not onboard issuers or investors, or advertise any offer, before the license certificate is physically or electronically delivered.
required_dossiers: Formal application for the Equity Crowdfunding Portal Operating License under the SSC pilot programme
Notarized copies of the ERC and IRC
Company Charter and corporate governance manual, including conflict-of-interest, investor protection, and information disclosure rules
Bank escrow confirmation certificate evidencing the paid-in charter capital of VND 10 billion
Compliance manual covering KYC/AML procedures, suspicious transaction reporting, sanctions screening, and recordkeeping compliant with the Law on Anti-Money Laundering No. 14/2022/QH14
38-month business plan with projections of issuer pipeline, investor volume, revenues, and operating expenditures
Curriculum vitae and diplomas of the General Director, Chief Compliance Officer, and IT security officer
Technical documentation of the platform, including host server location, cloud service agreement, encryption standards, and audit log capabilities
Information security risk assessment prepared under Decision No. 27/2018/QĐ-TTg and Law on Cybersecurity No. 24/2018/QH14
Escrow service agreement with the selected licensed commercial bank and payment service integration schema
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the SSC issues a written request for additional documents or corrections, the applicant must respond within 30 days; suspension of the process is avoided by timely response. A denial must be accompanied by written reasoning; the applicant may submit a revised application after remedying the stated deficiencies, file an appeal with the Ministry of Finance within 30 days, or seek judicial review under the Law on Complaints and Denunciations. During the pilot phase, resubmissions are accepted in the next SSC assessment window at the discretion of the licensing committee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Fire Safety Certification and Physical Site Inspection for Head Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Provincial Police Department - Fire Prevention and Fighting (PCCC) Division; in Ho Chi Minh City: PC07; in Hanoi: PC07.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Before commencing fit-out works at the registered office, the company must submit the fire-safety design dossier for appraisal to the provincial PCCC police. Upon completion of fit-out, the company invites the PCCC inspection team for a technical acceptance test covering emergency exits, fire alarms, extinguishers, evacuation signage, and emergency generator capacity. Passing the inspection results in the issuance of a Fire Safety Acceptance Certificate, which is a precondition for legal occupation of the premises and for the SSC license. If the office occupies less than a specified area, a simplified self-assessment may apply, but the PCCC certificate should still be obtained to evidence occupational clearance.
required_dossiers: Fire safety design appraisal application (Form A.2 prescribed under Decree 136/2020/NĐ-CP)
Architectural and fire-alarm layout drawings certified by a licensed fire-protection consulting organization
Office lease agreement and building owner's existing fire safety certificate
Inventory of installed fire-extinguishing systems with installation and maintenance certificates
Emergency evacuation plan and fire-drill log if personnel are already employed
Copy of the ERC and office lease for the physical inspection record
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the technical acceptance test fails, the company must cure the noted deficiencies (e.g., replace extinguishers, add exit lighting) and schedule a reinspection at no additional statutory cost. In cases of minor non-compliance, the PCCC chief may issue a temporary conditional operating permit for the office while corrections are made, allowing the company to proceed with licensure steps. Any refusal of the certificate must be in writing with reasons; an appeal can be filed with the provincial police leadership or the Administrative Court.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: General Department of Taxation (Tổng cục Thuế, 'GDT') of the Ministry of Finance (Bộ Tài chính), Socialist Republic of Vietnam; online taxpayer service portals: https://etaxvn.gdt.gov.vn (e-tax filing and account activation), https://hoadondientu.gdt.gov.vn (e-invoice clearance and stamping); national enterprise registration system: https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: The foreign investor first secures an Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) where required and then applies for the Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC) through the National Business Registration Portal. The statutory Tax Identification Number (MST - Mã số thuế) is automatically granted simultaneously with the ERC by the integrated national registration system under the Enterprise Law No. 59/2020/QH14 and the Law on Tax Administration No. 38/2019/QH14. After incorporation, the foreign-invested LLC must (i) file any supplementary tax registration via Form 01-ĐK-TCT with the provincial tax department (Cục Thuế) having jurisdiction over the registered head office, including registration of branches and secondary establishments; (ii) procure a qualified electronic signature (chữ ký số) from a licensed certificate authority; (iii) activate its e-tax account at https://etaxvn.gdt.gov.vn; and (iv) register its e-invoice template and digital signature on the GDT e-invoice system under Decree 123/2020/ND-CP before issuing any invoices.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation; a resident corporate taxpayer (foreign-invested LLC) is subject to Corporate Income Tax at the 20% standard rate on worldwide income under the CIT Law No. 14/2008/QH12 as amended by Law No. 32/2013/QH13, Law No. 71/2014/QH13 and Law No. 130/2024/QH15; income derived outside Vietnam remains taxable unless relieved under a double-tax treaty; income from foreign digital intermediation services retains Vietnamese source character where the service is performed in Vietnam. Territorial_Scope concessions and Tax_Exempt_Zone regimes (export processing zones, high-tech parks, economic zones under Decree 82/2021/ND-CP) exist but are not inherent to a licensed equity crowdfunding portal and would require physical establishment in the designated zone plus a separate investment incentive certificate.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Vietnam has no check-the-box classification regime. Available statutory elections and safeguards include: (i) CIT loss carry-forward election for up to 5 consecutive years (Law No. 71/2014/QH13); (ii) VAT credit-method vs. direct/deduction-method election (Law No. 106/2016/QH13; Circular 219/2013/TT-BTC); (iii) CIT incentive election for research/innovation activities under high-tech enterprise rules (Decree 82/2021/ND-CP); (iv) unilateral/bilateral/multilateral Advance Pricing Agreement application under Decree 132/2020/ND-CP and Circular 127/2024/TT-BTC; (v) hybrid mismatch limitation and related-party adjustment analysis under Decree 132/2020/ND-CP; and (vi) election to substantiate 0% VAT on qualifying offshore services with the statutory documentary bundle.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Value Added Tax — Thuế Giá Trị Gia Tăng), governed by Law No. 13/2008/QH12 as amended by Law No. 31/2013/QH13 and Law No. 106/2016/QH13, implemented by Circular 219/2013/TT-BTC, Decree 209/2013/ND-CP and Decree 49/2022/ND-CP.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VND 100,000,000 (one hundred million Vietnamese Dong) per annum of taxable turnover is the statutory threshold above which compulsory VAT registration applies (Decree 49/2022/ND-CP amending Decree 209/2013/ND-CP). An equity crowdfunding portal holding a State Securities Commission license and charging share-issuance success fees is a registered enterprise under the Enterprise Law, so VAT registration and credit-method taxation are mandatory from inception; no de minimis threshold applies to corporate taxpayers.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing under Decree 123/2020/ND-CP and Circular 78/2021/TT-BTC. The portal must transmit each e-invoice in XML format in real time to the GDT e-invoice system at https://hoadondientu.gdt.gov.vn over authenticated HTTPS APIs. For invoices requiring tax-authority clearance, the GDT assigns a tax authority code (mã của cơ quan thuế) before the invoice is legally effective; taxpayers satisfying Decree 123/2020/ND-CP conditions may issue code-less e-invoices but must transmit complete invoice data to the tax authority no later than one working day after issuance. All e-invoices must bear the taxpayer's registered digital signature, and the GDT performs automated cross-matching of invoice data against VAT returns, zero-rated export declarations, and bank payment documentation.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A 0% VAT rate applies where goods are physically exported through Vietnam customs procedures and where services are supplied to foreign organizations or individuals and are consumed wholly outside Vietnam (Circular 219/2013/TT-BTC as amended by Circular 25/2018/TT-BTC; Law No. 106/2016/QH13). For the crowdfunding portal, zero-rating on platform-orchestration services furnished to non-resident issuers is claimable only if the contract, service-completion record, and bank remittance documentation persuasively prove the service was performed and consumed outside Vietnam; Vietnamese tax administrative practice excludes domestic intermediation, brokerage, and liaison services from zero-rating, so substantial in-Vietnam platform infrastructure, local due-diligence, or investor solicitation will rebut the offshore-consumption test and recharacterize the fee as taxable at 10%.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration with electronic customs clearance receipt (Tờ khai hải quan hàng xuất khẩu) issued by the General Department of Vietnam Customs
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill evidencing physical export of goods (applicable to goods transactions only)

Inward Remittance Receipt or Bank Payment Confirmation (Xác nhận thanh toán qua ngân hàng) issued by the authorized settlement bank evidencing foreign-currency remittance from the foreign buyer or foreign issuer
Foreign purchase contract or offshore service agreement, together with a service completion acceptance record signed by the foreign counterparty
Commercial Invoice and complete international shipping documentation for freight transactions
E-invoice at 0% VAT transmitted to the GDT with the corresponding export voucher and payment references
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Post-refund audits (kiểm tra, thanh tra sau hoàn thuế) are conducted under Chapter VA of the Law on Tax Administration No. 38/2019/QH14 and Circular 80/2021/TT-BTC through documentary desk review and on-site inspection of the portal's books, underlying contracts, and FX remittance records. Unlawful refunds are retroactively clawed back with interest at 0.03% per day (or at the refinancing rate if higher), and an administrative penalty of 1 to 3 times the evaded or fraudulently refunded tax amount is imposed (Decree 125/2020/ND-CP as amended). Fraudulent export zero-rating or refund claims constitute tax evasion under Article 200 of the Penal Code No. 100/2015/QH13 as amended (fines up to VND 4.5 billion and imprisonment up to 7 years) and invoice forgery under Article 203; additionally, the State Securities Commission may suspend or revoke the crowdfunding platform license under Decree 10/2024/ND-CP for material compliance violations, and the State Bank of Vietnam may apply currency-control sanctions where FX repatriation exceeds the 180-day statutory deadline unless the governing export contract expressly stipulates a longer repatriation term permitted by Circular 05/2024/TT-NHNN.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Bank of Vietnam (SBV / Ngan hang Nha nuoc Viet Nam) is the central bank and the exclusive foreign-exchange regulator, operating under the Ordinance on Foreign Exchange and the implementing SBV circulars. For an equity crowdfunding portal classified as ISIC 6499, the SBV in coordination with the State Securities Commission of Vietnam (SSC) must confirm the permissible scope of the portal, the statutory escrow treatment of investor funds, and the bank authorizations required before any cross-border treasury transaction is opened.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vietnamese Dong (VND) is a managed-float, partially convertible currency. Current-account receipts are generally accessible through authorized banks but are subject to underlying-documentation review, while capital-account flows are restricted, registration-heavy, and transaction-locked. Equity contributions into a foreign-invested LLC must enter through a registered Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) at an SBV-licensed bank and must be mapped to the Investment Registration Certificate, Enterprise Registration Certificate, and capital-contribution schedule. Profit remittance is a supervised current-account outflow permitted only after audited financial statements and final tax settlement, executed through an authorized bank at the prevailing SBV reference rate. Offshore trading of VND is not permitted; all exchange transactions must occur inside the domestic authorized-bank market.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under Vietnamese foreign-exchange control, any resident entity receiving foreign-currency proceeds from exports or service revenues must repatriate the gross amount to a foreign-currency account held at an SBV-licensed bank and must surrender or convert 100% of those proceeds to VND within 15 days from the date of receipt, unless the authorized bank has approved a formal foreign-currency retention facility supported by underlying currency liabilities. The conversion rate is the bank's published buying rate on the value date, and the bank retains the export contract, customs declaration, invoice, or service agreement as part of the current-account file. For the crowdfunding portal, platform fees received in foreign currency are subject to the same repatriation and surrender discipline.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules_effectiv: The statutory surrender window for export proceeds is 15 calendar days from receipt; conversion ratio is 100% of the repatriated foreign-currency proceeds, subject to SBV-approved exceptions.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low feasibility as a primary treasury or escrow rail. Offshore digital EMIs are not licensed to hold Vietnamese resident funds, operate payment accounts, or execute domestic VND clearing without an SBV authorization as a credit institution or licensed intermediary payment service provider. An offshore EMI may function only as a non-regulated technology vendor for treasury accounting or as a foreign-currency disbursement capability strictly outside the Vietnamese domestic payment system. Statutory crowdfunding investor funds must remain in an explicitly designated client-money escrow account at an SBV-licensed commercial bank, never commingled with the portal's proprietary treasury.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: In-person KYC interview is effectively mandatory for a high-risk corporate client. At least one legal representative or an appointed director bearing an original notarized power of attorney must appear at the selected bank branch with original passports, visa or temporary residence card, Investment Registration Certificate, Enterprise Registration Certificate, company charter, beneficial-ownership declaration, and opening or latest audited financial statements. Remote or purely video-based corporate onboarding is not accepted for this risk class; the bank will conduct a four-eyes interview and independent verification of all signatory identities.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: The equity crowdfunding portal's statutory license or regulatory sandbox approval is pending, limited, or non-transparent, creating bank concern that the platform is conducting unlicensed securities intermediation or payment collection.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A current statutory license or official SBV/SSC sandbox approval expressly authorizing equity crowdfunding, the platform's published operating rules, standard investor agreement template, escrow agreement with the SBV-licensed custodian bank, and a Vietnamese legal opinion mapping ISIC 6499 to the permitted regulatory perimeter.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Multi-tier or non-transparent beneficial ownership involving foreign shareholders or offshore holding companies with incomplete documentation.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified corporate registry excerpts for each legal-person shareholder, a complete list of natural-person ultimate beneficial owners with 10% or greater interest, valid passports and resident permits, notarized powers of attorney, source-of-wealth statements supported by bank statements and tax records, and tax-residence certificates for each UBO.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unusually large volumes of small incoming transfers into the escrow account within short time windows, flagged as structuring, smurfing, or round-tripping by investor funds.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete investor KYC files with national ID or passport data, executed investment subscription agreements, portal transaction logs, investor risk assessments, AML/CTF and transaction-monitoring policy documents, and a real-time escalation protocol for suspicious-transaction reports to the State Bank of Vietnam.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Incoming wires from sanctioned jurisdictions, cryptocurrency exchanges, or unlicensed virtual-asset service providers.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Denied-party-screening results, sanctions-clearing software evidence, counterparty LEI and bank IBAN documentation, a board-approved sanctions and embargo policy, a contractual prohibition on crypto-derived funding, and an executed legal statement confirming that the platform is not a virtual-asset service provider.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All inbound equity injections must be routed by SWIFT MT103 or local interbank transfer to the LLC's registered DICA at an SBV-licensed bank. The remitter field must identify the legal investing entity, the message purpose code must align with FDI equity contribution or capital participation, and the reference field must contain the Investment Registration Certificate number. The bank verifies the amount against the approved capital-contribution schedule, converts foreign currency into VND at the authorized daily rate, and credits the operating or designated escrow account. For crowdfunding investor subscriptions, funds must be received into a statutory client-money escrow account at the licensed bank, individually attributed to each investor and segregated from proprietary liquidity; no internal netting or commingling is permissible.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Cross-border vendor payments and distribution payments to non-residents are executed through SWIFT MT103 from the operating FX account with the underlying contract, invoice, tax clearance, and board authorization retained for audit. Trade-based goods settlements may be supported by an irrevocable commercial letter of credit issued under UCP600 through a nominated local or foreign bank. Domestic disbursements to portfolio companies, issuers, and service providers are settled in VND through the SBV interbank electronic payment system or NAPAS ACH, subject to batch authorization, duplicate-funds verification, and a full audit trail. Escrow outflows require a signed disbursement instruction matching the completed crowdfunding offering and the exact investor-allocation schedule.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX forward contracts against VND with an SBV-licensed credit institution, supported by documented trade or financial exposure and a maturity cap under SBV derivative regulations.
FX swaps between VND and foreign currencies, including spot-forward and forward-forward combinations.
Cross-currency swaps for long-dated foreign-currency liabilities, subject to SBV derivative licensing and underlying-deal verification.
FX options, including vanilla options and simple collar structures, used strictly for hedging commercial exposures and not for speculative trading.

Onshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are not an authorized instrument for VND; offshore NDFs cannot be used by Vietnamese residents for hedging, so all permissible hedging must be deliverable through an SBV-licensed bank.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Department of Planning and Investment via the National Business Registration Information Portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No later than 31 March annually for the preceding calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines under Decree 122/2021/NĐ-CP; chronic non-filing may trigger administrative strike-off and revocation of the Enterprise Registration Certificate.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Business License Fee Declaration and Payment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Tax Department via the General Department of Taxation eTax system
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 31 January annually; newly established enterprises are exempt for the first year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment interest on arrears, administrative tax fines, coercive collection, and possible suspension of business operations.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Finalization Return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Department of Taxation through the managing provincial Tax Department
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 90th day after fiscal-year end; calendar-year companies file by 31 March
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-return penalties, penalty interest on tax arrears, underpayment assessments, and enforced tax collection measures.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Tax Department, provincial Department of Finance, General Statistics Office, and applicable sectoral regulator
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Accounting-law administrative sanctions; regulatory sanctions for licensed portals; failure to file may impair CIT finalization and trigger tax enforcement.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Investment Project Performance Report for Foreign-Invested Enterprise
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Department of Planning and Investment / Investment Registration Agency
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after the end of the fiscal year; quarterly reports are due within 15 days after quarter-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines under the Investment Law; continuing non-compliance may be deemed a material failure of commitments and lead to project suspension or termination.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Regulatory Compliance Report for Licensed Equity Crowdfunding Portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Securities Commission of Vietnam; State Bank of Vietnam on AML/FIU matters where applicable
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after fiscal-year end or as prescribed in the operating licence
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Supervisory remediation orders, administrative fines, suspension of the digital-intermediation licence, or revocation of the equity crowdfunding licence.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Statutory audit is mandatory for all foreign-invested enterprises and licensed securities/intermediary entities. Independent audit is also required for enterprises meeting the materiality thresholds under Decree 17/2018/NĐ-CP (annual revenue at or above VND 50 billion, total assets at or above VND 25 billion, or workforce at or above 100 employees), for parent companies, and for public-interest entities.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Vietnamese Accounting Standards under the Law on Accounting 2015 and Circular 200/2014/TT-BTC; IFRS is optional only for specified enterprises with State approval and is not generally mandatory for an unlisted foreign-invested LLC.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Vietnam has no separate annual UBO declaration to the business registry. Under the AML Law 2022, the crowdfunding portal must identify beneficial owners of each investor and corporate client, refresh the UBO risk profile at least annually and on triggering events, and keep records for 10 years. Changes in members or capital-contribution transfers must be recorded in the Register of Members and notified to the Business Registration Office within 10 days of the change; no additional annual re-confirmation is required.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 400 - USD 1,500 per year depending on agent services and registered-office location in Ho Chi Minh City or Hanoi
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 5,000 - USD 15,000 for a regulated crowdfunding intermediary with escrow operations and audited financial statements

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Standard CIT 20%. No automatic holiday for crowdfunding portal; potential preferential 10% for 15 years if licensed project qualifies under software/high-tech zones and AIA; SME preferential rates may apply only to micro/small enterprises; all rates remain subject to strict conditions.
